title: Benchmarking Arabic Dialects for Math Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.28607v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mathematical reasoning remains underexplored for low-resource languages, including Dialectal Arabic. To bridge this gap, we introduce the DAR-MGSM (Dialectal Arabic Multilingual Grade School Math) Benchmark, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic. DAR-MGSM consists of math word problems (MWPs) requiring multi-step reasoning and covers five major Arabic dialects alongside Modern Standard Arabic (MSA). The benchmark comprises two parallel versions: translated-only and translated & culturally localized. The latter version adapts entities and references to regional varieties. We evaluate eleven Arabic-centric and multilingual large language models on DAR-MGSM. The results show that the performance generally declines on the localized version, highlighting the challenges introduced by culturally grounded adaptations. translated_title: 阿拉伯方言数学问题基准测试
translated_abstract: 数学推理在包括阿拉伯方言在内的低资源语言中仍然缺乏充分研究。为了弥合这一差距，我们推出了DAR-MGSM（阿拉伯方言多语言小学数学）基准，这是首个用于评估阿拉伯方言数学推理能力的人工整理基准。DAR-MGSM由需要多步推理的数学应用题（MWPs）组成，涵盖五种主要阿拉伯方言以及现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）。该基准包含两个平行版本：仅翻译版本和翻译并文化本地化版本，后一版本将实体和引用调整为区域性变体。我们在DAR-MGSM上评估了十一个以阿拉伯语为中心的多语言大语言模型。结果显示，模型在本地化版本上的性能普遍下降，凸显了文化背景适应所带来的挑战。然而，这种影响的程度因模型而异。
tldr: 该论文推出了首个用于评估阿拉伯方言数学推理的人工整理基准DAR-MGSM，涵盖五种主要阿拉伯方言及现代标准阿拉伯语，并发现大语言模型在文化本地化版本上性能普遍下降。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DAR-MGSM, the first manually curated benchmark for evaluating mathematical reasoning in Dialectal Arabic across five major dialects and Modern Standard Arabic, showing that LLM performance generally declines on culturally localized versions.
